events.title: Steam NextFest! Feature on itch! MORE!
events.summary: Hello ma doodz yhoooo it has been a while since the Episode 2 demo dropped!So, what's been happening? Well, a few things:Episode 2 got featured on the front page of itch! That's amazing! They even recorded a full playthrough video of it - nice!Episode 1 sold 1,644 copies on Steam. That's pretty cool!Episode 1 has a new Russian and an Italian translation in the game, thanks to 2 kind volunteers who reached out. I'm testing the new build and will hopefully push it live on Steam in the next 2 weeks

events.title: Demo released!
events.summary: Friends of the Bru & Boegie clan - we did it. It took almost a year of full-time development to get this Episode 2 demo over the line. Today is a momentous day. I only ask that you enjoy it, and if you do enjoy it, please Wishlist it.Thanks for playing! 🙏❤️

events.title: Steam Deck Works Great!
events.summary: I'm pleased to announce that Bru & Boegie: Episode 2 - Get da SUGAR! works flawlessly out the box on the Steam Deck!The input is simple - left click to interact, right click to examine, the right trackpad works as a mouse, and either clicking in the trackpad serves as a click or using the right and left bumper triggers for left and right mouse clicks serve the same purpose. 👍The hamburger button serves as 'Esc' which brings up the Pause Menu.And that's about it! events.title: Demo launching Friday 10 July!
events.summary: Peeps, good news - it seems like all my ducks are now in a row and - all things being equal - looking set to launch the demo for Episode 2 next week Friday 10th July!It's been a long road to this point, and I so look forward to putting this game in your hands.Until then - stay keef. 🙌🙏
